company.name: Modern Treasury
company.shortDescription: Modern Treasury offers a payment operations platform to simplify and modernize business payments.
company.description:
Modern Treasury enables its clients to marry bank statements with the company’s business logic to provide an enriched history of the company’s financial transactions. This view will empower the company’s finance teams to focus on solving the mission-critical problems of the business and not piecing together the jigsaw puzzle of bank transactions by hand. Modern Treasury will help answer those questions faster and with more confidence.

The company's tools automate the full cycle of money movement—from payment initiation, through approvals, to reconciliation—and are accessible through a web application or API.

productsAndServices.description: An API-driven payment infrastructure product for automating money movement across ACH, wires, FedNow, RTP, and stablecoin payment rails.
productsAndServices.name: Payments

productsAndServices.description: A scalable, API-driven ledger for recording transactions, tracking balances, and providing real-time visibility into money movement.
